messages:
maya: Quick sync  new webinar concept: "Hands-on Dedicated Deployments". Goal = 45m interactive + clear post-event leads. thoughts?
raj: Love it. Lean into measurable outcomes: show 2 concise benchmark callouts up front (cost and p95 latency).
claire: We should offer localized landing pages (EN/ES/FR) and a short Spanish intro from our EU customer. I can draft abstracts + bullets for each locale.
sam: Demo owner note: I need a 10-min prod-like smoke window with synthetic traffic. Available Wed 11:00 PT or Fri 08:00 PT. Prefer Wed.
josh: Rehearsals: reserve Wed 10:00 PT (tech smoke) and Sun 16:00 PT (run-through). Will include playback test for captions and recorded intro.
zoe: Ops plan: registrants -> HubSpot "dedicated_hands_on_2026"; attendees -> add property webinar_attended=true; hot engagement (asked demo or clicked trial) -> tag "webinar_hot" + SDR task within 4h. ops-bot: task rule scheduled.
maya: Run-of-show proposal (45m): 1m bilingual intro (pre-recorded), 6m bench highlights + methodology, 12m customer story (EU/reg), 10m live demo, 10m labs (3 parallel micro-labs) + 6m wrap/CTAs — labs run during Q&A.
raj: Labs idea: a) routing policy tweak, b) small perf run (5k tokens), c) quick cost-tuning exercise. Keep lab guides single-page each.
claire: Speaker kit: 2-sentence bio, 1-line talk summary, 3 key bullets, headshot, pronouns by Mon EOD. Ill reach out to speakers with localized copy.
sam: If live demo fails, play 5m recorded full demo and pivot to labs & panel. Josh, can you cue fallback?
josh: Yes. Ill host the fallback MP4 and a 30s social clip. Also will prepare a triage sheet for Q&A tags: sales, product-bug, follow-up.
zoe: Post-event sequences: immediate recording email + bench deck; 24h personalized outreach to hot leads; add to 6-week nurture with lab invites. UTM convention: utm_campaign=dedicated_hands_on_2026.
maya: Copy ask: headline emphasizing "predictable inference economics" + subhead about concrete cost delta. Raj, can you confirm a provisional stat we can use for promo?
raj: Provisional: "up to 3x token cost reduction with batching + KV cache" (will validate and replace if needed).
ops-bot: Reminder set: upload bilingual intro mp4 by Tue 18:00 PT; rehearsal Wed 10:00 PT; run-through Sun 16:00 PT; webinar Thu 11:00 PT.
maya: Need volunteer to moderate live Q&A and escalate product issues to eng-oncall. Sam can moderate if Josh runs the fallback.
sam: I can moderate. Will keep a pinned sheet of top questions and flag hot leads.
maya: Great. Keep notes in this thread for any changes. :raised_hands:
